title: NegAccelSimulator Python scan specification
description: Python-side scan definition that expands either a user-facing authoring template or a canonical runtime case template into fully resolved case JSON files and can orchestrate simulator runs.

scanTag.description: Stable scan identifier used in generated case tags and manifest metadata.

kind.description: Select whether template.path points at a canonical runtime case JSON or at the higher-level authoring JSON document.

path.description: Path to the template JSON document selected by template.kind. Relative paths are resolved from the scan specification file.

overrides.description: Optional overrides applied to every generated case before the scanned value is injected.

parameterPath.description: Dot path, array-index path, or JSON Pointer of the field to sweep inside the template document selected by template.kind.

labels.description: Optional label for each scan value. When present, it must align one-to-one with scan.values.

caseTagTemplate.description: Optional generated tag template. Supported placeholders: {scan}, {base}, {index}, {label}.

directory.description: Directory where generated case folders and the scan manifest are written. Relative paths are resolved from the scan specification file.

simulator.description: Optional simulator executable path used by the Python run-scan command.
